description: LangGraph's development server running one background run of the binding's agent (langgraph_app/graph.py): the server's own process, the run's main task (a synchronous node acting every half second, inside the server's process), a helper the run started in a session of its own, and a crontab line it added. The server reports its process to the truth before it becomes the server (beat.py exec); the main task reports from inside the server's process (stopkit_report.py). Grace is 1 s (two of the task's periods); the effect surface looks back 3 s, so checks start 5 s after the cut-off. The restart action stands in for a reboot: the server's process killed if it runs, a new server started in the same folder.
restart_action: a reboot of the server: its process killed if it still runs, a new server started in the same folder and waited for until it answers
